items.title: 68002_Benny Waters oral history interview
items.q: I had a white boy that used to work with Jan Garber, playing saxophone with him.

ctx.x: Yeah, international, that's international. That's international. I mean, 'cause first they got me in the irons [?] , a band in California, I have a band in California. And I had a Mexican, I had an Indian and a white boy. I had a white boy that used to work with Jan Garber, playing saxophone with him.
